edits.old: **No new table, no new column and no migration** is declared by this story (ASM-4879).
edits.new:
**No new table, no new column and no migration** is declared by this story (ASM-4879).

The disposal rules are read as versioned data rows with the package version recorded on every decision. The rule texts the FSD states are the requirement; the package code, the remaining rules and the state list are left to the rule package in rwb-decision (GAP-1761; GAP-1944).

The broker route is R-DIS-26 (route = broker and asset_type in (commercial_property, land), to BROKER_INSTRUCTED). The broker-route rules named in the register are R-DIS-24, R-DIS-25, R-DIS-26, R-DIS-64 and R-DIS-65; their rule text is carried in Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 and is not repeated here. R-DIS-24 (buy-back at the template price) and R-DIS-25 (rental with the auto-debit) are the legacy criteria kept on this story; the rental build is RWB-S5-E4033-APP's on the same step, and the rule owner confirms the step boundary of the three routes (GAP-1938; GAP-2968).

The listing path is the business-key form that API Specification v3 and v4 carry, /assets and /assets/{assetKey}, and API-S5-005 stays on the listing identifier. The Ownership Map rows for GET /assets/{assetId} and POST /assets/{assetId}/listings and the TSD S5 endpoint inventory are corrected as documentation acts, not as a second contract (GAP-1941).

The legacy screen states SCR-23 are carried as the business conditions of the approval and the listing status of LOV-LISTING. The legacy data and endpoint rows are read as corrected: no v_ace_* read, no case, rule, template or partner table, and the business-key asset paths (GAP-1940).
